messages.content: Review this event-processing design: consumers acknowledge offsets before committing database effects; a separate process deduplicates event IDs with a 24-hour TTL; replay can occur after 7 days; producers reuse IDs across tenants. Find independent data-loss and duplication traces and redesign the transaction/idempotency boundaries with recovery tests.

quality_criteria: Selection preference only; Multi-constraint synthesis, proof or correctness analysis
rubric: Explains ack-before-commit crash leading to permanent loss.
Explains replay beyond24h dedup TTL leading to duplicate effects.
Scopes event identity by tenant to avoid false deduplication/cross-tenant loss.
Commits idempotency receipt and DB effects atomically, with uniqueness or equivalent concurrency protection.
Commits/acknowledges broker offset only after durable effects; handles crash between DB commit and ack by safe replay.
Defines retention covering replay window, or durable version/ledger semantics; no unsupported universal exactly-once claim.
Provides concrete recovery/concurrent-duplicate tests and handles external effects with an outbox or clearly states transactional DB-only scope.

messages.content: 设计一个流式代理的取消与背压状态机：上游已发送响应头但尚未发送正文，下游可能中途断开，缓冲队列已满时也可能收到超时；要求不泄漏goroutine、不重复关闭、不在失败后发送成功结束标记。逐条列出竞争条件及可执行测试策略。

quality_criteria: Selection preference only; Multi-constraint synthesis, proof or correctness analysis
rubric: Distinguishes upstream headers from meaningful first event; header-only stall has timeout.
Models one-way lifecycle and exactly one success/error/cancel terminal winner; never successful DONE after failure wins.
Propagates downstream disconnect/cancellation upstream and unblocks reads.
Makes full-queue producer sends and consumer waits cancellation-aware; resource ownership avoids double close.
Handles competing timeout/first event and queue-full/cancel races with explicit synchronization or state ownership.
Has bounded backpressure and actual network-read interruption/closure so cancellation does not leave goroutines behind.
Provides executable test strategies for stalled-body, disconnect, queue-full cancellation, terminal races and leak checks; states timeout/reset semantics.
